author: Burgan Tech vNext Platform Team
name: vNext Integration Test Project
description: A ready-to-run xUnit integration test project wired to VNext.Testing.Sdk. Includes Testcontainers-based Docker stack (PostgreSQL, Redis, Vault, Dapr), VNextApiClient, and example smoke tests.

DomainName.description: Pascal-case domain name used as the C# namespace and project name prefix (e.g. MorphFx, PortfolioManager).

AppDomain.description: Lower-case domain slug used in vNext API paths and container env vars (e.g. morphfx, portfolio-manager).

VNextImage.description: Base container image for vNext orchestrator and execution services.

SdkVersion.description: Version of the VNext.Testing.Sdk NuGet package to reference.
